entries.title: The keyboard stays where you clicked
entries.body: When you click into the task board, a card or a panel and then switch back to the app, the keyboard is still on what you clicked. Before, if a new card had arrived behind it while you were away, the keyboard could jump to the message box or go nowhere.
entries.noPicture: The fix is where the keyboard's focus goes when the window comes forward, which a still picture cannot show.
